ideas.title: The Impact of Medicaid Fraud on Minnesota's Healthcare System
ideas.description: An investigation into the effects of Medicaid fraud on Minnesota's healthcare system.
ideas.angle: The financial and systemic impacts of fraud on healthcare services.
questions: What are the financial impacts of Medicaid fraud?
How does fraud affect healthcare services in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: Understanding the scope of Medicaid fraud and its effects on the healthcare system is crucial for addressing the issue.

ideas.title: The Rise of Nonprofit Mismanagement and Fraud
ideas.description: An investigation into the rise of mismanagement and fraud in nonprofit organizations.
ideas.angle: The causes and consequences of nonprofit mismanagement and fraud.
questions: What are the common causes of nonprofit mismanagement and fraud?
How can nonprofits prevent mismanagement and fraud?
ideas.insight: Analyzing data on nonprofit organizations can help identify trends and patterns in mismanagement and fraud.
